# LUMOS Projector

> > LUMOS is a Singapore-based brand offering affordable home cinema projectors (1080p & 720p from $199) alongside tablets, cameras, and audio accessories with 5-star customer reviews.

LUMOS specializes in portable, short-throw projectors like the AURO V2 and FLOAT, certified by Netflix and YouTube. The brand also produces complementary smart devices including tablets, digital cameras, and party speakers, primarily serving the Singapore market.

- [LUMOS AURO V2 Home Cinema Projector](https://lumosprojector.com/products/lumos-auro-v2-home-cinema-short-throw-projector): Flagship LUMOS AURO V2 Netflix & YouTube certified short-throw projector
- [LUMOS FLOAT Home Cinema Projector](https://lumosprojector.com/products/lumos-float-projector): LUMOS FLOAT 360-degree rotatable projector starting from $199
- [LUMOS DAYSTAR](https://lumosprojector.com/products/lumos-daystar): LUMOS DAYSTAR 2-in-1 home and business projector with auto-focus
